svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Modeling: PyTorch, YOLO OBB, OpenCV, NumPy, scikit-learn, Hugging Face. Inference: TensorRT, Triton, ONNX Runtime, TFLite, NGINX, Flask. Platform: AWS EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Docker, Helm, Kubernetes. MLOps: DVC, uv, GitHub Actions, pytest, Ruff, pre-commit. GenAI: LangGraph, Ollama, Qdrant, ChromaDB, FastAPI, React.
